In the past, I’ve had an opportunity to assist native adult speakers with their English skills. This experience has played a role in how I help students today.
 
I’ve been an online English teacher for nearly 5 years and have taught upwards of 5000 lessons. I have seen almost any situation a non native might be in, so can likely help you too!
teacher_info.teaching_style:
My lesson methodology is quite simple... I do what works for you as an individual. 

Everyone is different. Methods often work differently from person to person. Spending a sufficient amount of time on any task is important to make sure its understood well.

Slow and steady wins the race. Therefore, it's my goal to provide a comfortable, modernized, relaxing environment for you to improve your English.  

My sessions tend to be quite interactive with articles, video clips and other useful media. Some people prefer a more (strict) style of teacher. If that is what you like, I may not be the person you are looking for.  My style is intentionally relaxed. However, please check for yourself!

*Note - When a lesson is not cancelled within 24 hours, it is not fair for anyone. Other students cannot use that time slot which means I cannot book another student for that time and have to find more time to complete the missed lesson.

teacher_info.introduction: In university, I completed a minor in German. Many of my friends were international students, often with limited English skills. I took pride in my ability to adapt my language to the appropriate level as they progressed. I learned Esperanto by email, but very soon my wife and I got involved with the community. We regularly sought opportunities to speak face to face. In a short time, the people I considered my mentors were seeking my input on how to express fine shades of meaning. Through two decades, I have seen a broad range of backgrounds. Different explanations work for different people. Some aspects need more attention. Some common explanations are actually best avoided. Since Esperanto was our home language, I have accumulated songs, games, and other methods that are suitable for younger children. M y 11 year old son and I created a course. I volunteer with the boy scouts, teaching and mentoring boys from 6-17. Through organizing Esperanto events, I have the opportunity to work with both beginners and more experienced self-learners who find themselves speaking Esperanto for the first time. This can be scary, but we've all been there. I can help you over these jitters, and to move beyond translating phrases to actively thinking in the language. This is an exciting time for Esperanto. New technology allows us not only to read and write, but for conversation as well. You need a teacher with experience actually speaking the language. It's good to start with good pronunciation, but it's never too late. NOTE FOR ENGLISH LEARNERS: Although my profile emphasizes other languages, I want you to know that I take teaching English seriously. I teach English locally and work with students from total beginner to near-native - ages 8 to 80. I will encourage you to work on your communication skills and being understood. I enjoy meeting new people, traveling, going to great New York City museums, and reading. As I spent several years studying and working in France, I have experienced firsthand the challenge and thrill of learning a second language and living abroad.
teacher_info.about_teacher: I am an experienced ESL teacher and have taught in both France and in the United States.  I have taught beginner, intermediate, and advanced classes and have experience teaching in classrooms and also giving online classes. I received my Teaching English to Speakers of Other Languages  (TESOL) Certificate  from Teachers College, Columbia University.
teacher_info.teaching_style: I truly believe that language learning should be fun and interesting. In my classes, I  have a learner-centered approach to teaching and help students to achieve their language goals. My classes will prepare students to tackle real-life situations in English. Each lesson will be adapted to a learner's needs and goals.

course_info.trial_description:
Join me for a trial lesson! I am a native English speaker and have a TESOL Certificate. I also have experience teaching in a classroom setting, providing online classes, and giving business English lessons onsite.

In the trial lesson, we will first discuss your language goals. Next, I will explain how I can help you reach these goals and the kind of activities that would be the most helpful.  We will also conduct a mini English lesson on one of the following themes.

1. Fun and Useful English Expressions (Idioms)
2. Interviews in English (Overview and Role-Play)
3. English Shopping Vocabulary (Level appropriate)
4. English for Travel (Vocabulary and Role-Play)
5. English Food Vocabulary (Role-Play and Key Terms)

pro_course_detail.title: General English for All Levels Beginners to Advanced (A1 to C1)
pro_course_detail.description:
In this class, you will practice English through acquiring new theme based vocabulary, reviewing and applying grammar rules, and having many opportunities to express yourself in English on the lesson topic. Classes can include role-plays, games, and grammar and writing exercises. Each class will be on a specific theme. For example food, greetings, email writing, shopping vocabulary, key phrases for travel, English for use at the bank, etc.

I am a native English speaker and have a TESOL Certificate from Teachers College, Columbia University. I have taught English both in the classroom and online. I am patient, speak clearly, and always encourage students to ask questions.

pro_course_detail.title: English Conversation Practice
pro_course_detail.description:
In this class, you will have the opportunity to practice speaking English on a preselected theme. I will provide feedback on pronunciation and highlight key theme related vocabulary words.

I am a native English speaker and have a TESOL Certificate from Teachers College, Columbia University. I also have many years of language teaching experience and have taught English in France and in the United States. I am patient and speak slowly.

pro_course_detail.title: Writing in English
pro_course_detail.description:
In this class, you will practice writing in English and improve your writing skills. We will discuss structure and vocabulary choice. Feel free to bring in your own writing or I can also provide  you with writing prompts. You will receive feedback and become more confident writing in English.
